🔄 TCGPLAYER MASS PRICE SYNC Updates Webflow prices based on condition
Pokemon cards use PokemonTCG.io market data as the TCGPlayer-backed source and update Webflow by stored condition. NM→TCG mid, LP→80%, MP→64%, HP→40%, DMG→25%. Only affects TCG items with a known set.
Tap PREVIEW to see what will be updated before running.

SCANNER
One button. Point the camera at a sports/Pokemon/One Piece card, a product barcode, or a graded slab's barcode -- tap Scan and it figures out which.
Opening camera...
Results are added straight to the Research results below — close this window any time to review them. Prices are always real market data (PriceCharting / JustTCG / PokemonPriceTracker / PSA), never AI-guessed. Graded slab cert lookups are PSA only today — BGS/CGC/SGC barcodes aren't a supported cert format yet.

🛒 ADD TO CART

Adds this item to the cart at the price below. Payment method is chosen during checkout — this does not finalize a sale.

🛒 ADD ONE-OFF TO CART

For items not in inventory yet — adds a one-off line to the cart. Payment is chosen at checkout; this does not finalize a sale.

🎁 SELL GIFT CARD

Adds a gift card line to the cart. The code is generated and printable only after the sale finalizes at checkout.

🏆 NEW EVENT

📚 NEW SERIES

🏷️ PRINT LABELS

Sheet mode prints multiple labels per page with dashed cut lines -- works on plain paper or Avery-style sheets. Roll mode prints exactly one label per "page" sized to match a direct-thermal roll printer (no margins, no cut lines needed). Toploader-wrap layout is meant for roll labels: stick the left half to the front over the toploader's edge, fold at the dashed line, and the barcode half lands on the back. Barcode value uses UPC, then SKU, then falls back to the item's internal ID.
